_doc: Founding years for fintech candidates found only in the App Store Finance chart (no YC Fintech or Wikidata fintech classification). Such a candidate counts as fintech only if founded in 2000 or later (methodology.md §1). Added only for candidates the selector actually reaches; each year has a source. A year is recorded only when the Wikidata entry's official website (P856) matches the domain; other candidates are resolved one by one if reached.
